rows.text: You encounter a group of ancient bloodthirsty behemoths in an ancient city of an abandoned star system. Their hot, steamy breaths brush against your face...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You notice signs of mutation on one of them... Its skin is covered by a layer of gilded hard shell, and it seems to be suffering from the mutation.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You stare straight into its droopy eyes. Its whiskers are moving up and down. You notice it is protecting some cubs behind it...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Enter combat. After achieving victory, obtain a 2-star Blessing.
Enter combat. After achieving victory, obtain a 3-star Blessing and 1 Curio.
